check: MOE2 independent preservation from MOE1 only

scope.comparison: Raw bytes; no newline or whitespace normalization.
scope.rfc_rule: The entire baseline original-source suffix must remain contiguous at the target's original-source heading; new trailing appendices are allowed.
scope.adr_rule: Every existing keyed ADR_SOURCE block, including marker lines, must retain its bytes and occurrence order for that key.
scope.beacon_rule: Every existing paired TB1/FOW1 comment block must retain its bytes. Unpaired numbering markers are counted separately; their following mutable index text is not treated as a protected block.
scope.moe1_rule: Every existing paired MOE1 block must retain its exact bytes and per-key occurrence order. New MOE2 sections may supersede these historical decisions without rewriting their protected records.
scope.archival_rule: Existing files under any history/evidence/audit/audits directory and previous maintenance/revisions directories are compared whole.
scope.target_only_files: Ignored, including this revision and before/*.md.txt; archived-original completeness is audited separately.

legacy_checker_status.claim: This PASS means preservation only. It does not change, clear, or supersede any FAIL from the old documentation or integrity checkers.
legacy_checker_status.limitations: No link-validity, current-source-manifest acceptance, protocol safety, native implementation, or economic correctness claim is made.
